title: Third Conditional (Past Regrets)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora puedes analizar el pasado y hablar sobre oportunidades perdidas usando el Tercer Condicional.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Tercer Condicional para hablar de situaciones en el PASADO que no ocurrieron y sus consecuencias imaginarias. 
Estructura: IF + Pasado Perfecto (had + participio) , WOULD HAVE + Participio.
parts.audio: We use the Third Conditional to talk about situations in the past that did not happen, and their imaginary consequences. The structure is: If, plus Past Perfect, comma, plus Would Have, plus a Past Participle.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: 
IF we HAD LAUNCHED earlier, we WOULD HAVE SOLD more (Si hubiéramos lanzado antes, habríamos vendido más). 
IF I HAD KNOWN the deadline, I WOULDN'T HAVE BEEN late (Si hubiera sabido la fecha límite, no habría llegado tarde).
parts.audio: Examples. If we had launched earlier, we would have sold more. Another example: If I had known the deadline, I wouldn't have been late.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Tercer Condicional.

questions.question: If we ____ the contract, we would have lost the client. (No hubiéramos firmado).
If they had offered a better price, we ____ it. (Lo habríamos aceptado).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia en el pasado = would have + participio (accepted).

questions.question: I ____ to the meeting if you had told me about it. (Habría ido).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia de algo que no pasó = would have gone.

questions.question: If she ____ the email, she would have known about the problem. (Hubiera leído).
We would have won the project if our presentation ____ better. (Hubiera sido).
questions.explanation: If + past perfect de 'to be' = had been.

questions.question: If I had seen the error, I ____ you. (Te habría dicho).
The company ____ bankrupt if they hadn't secured the loan. (Habría quebrado).
If you ____ earlier, you would have met the CEO. (Hubieras llegado - arrive).
If we had invested in that startup, we ____ a lot of money. (Habríamos ganado/hecho).
questions.explanation: Would have made a lot of money.

questions.question: I wouldn't have missed the flight if the taxi ____ late. (No hubiera llegado).
questions.explanation: If the taxi hadn't been late (Si no hubiera llegado tarde).

questions.question: What ____ you ____ if they had rejected your proposal? (¿Qué habrías hecho?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta: What would you have done?

questions.question: If they ____ market research, the launch wouldn't have failed. (Hubieran hecho - do).
If he had prepared for the interview, he ____ the job. (Habría conseguido).
We ____ the deadline if the system hadn't crashed. (Habríamos cumplido - meet).
questions.explanation: Would have met the deadline (Habríamos cumplido la fecha).

questions.question: If I ____ that you were in town, we could have had lunch. (Hubiera sabido).
questions.explanation: If + past perfect de know = had known.

questions.question: They wouldn't have sued us if we ____ the mistake immediately. (Hubiéramos arreglado).
If the marketing team ____ a better campaign, sales would have been higher. (Hubiera creado).
She would have been promoted if she ____ that big mistake. (No hubiera cometido).
If we had listened to the customers, we ____ this problem now. Wait... 'now' indica condicional mixto, pero asume consecuencia pasada: we ____ the problem yesterday. (Habríamos evitado).
We ____ the contract if you had given us more time. (Habríamos firmado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el Tercer Condicional (had + participio / would have + participio).

questions.question: If we ____ (had) more time, we would have finished. (Hubiéramos tenido)
questions.explanation: had had (el primer 'had' es el auxiliar, el segundo es el verbo principal en participio).

questions.question: If I had known, I ____ (would have) told you.
If she ____ (be) late, she would have missed the flight. (Hubiera estado)
We would have lost the client if we ____ (not fix) it.
What ____ you have done? (Habrías)
If they ____ (offer) a discount, we would have bought it.
I would have gone if you ____ (invite) me.
If we had invested, we would ____ (make) a profit.
If I ____ (know), I wouldn't have gone.
The company would ____ (go) bankrupt.

pairs.source: If she had read the email...
I wouldn't have missed the flight...
If the presentation had been better...
We would have met the deadline...

stages.title: Listening Comprehension

If we signed the contract, we would have lost.
